An old school alien titan weapon for sci fi games in 28mm scale. This is large flying assault monster armed with bio-cannons on it's wings as well as devastating scything claws. Also known to be used as a dropship for smaller alien flyers.

A scaled down full version in 6mm scale is included with the larger 28/30mm scale split model, though obviously size it to your own uses.

On the large version the limbs and wings are separate, one of each limb is provided and can be mirrored in your slicer software to get the opposite number. Supports will be required.
